facts.text: Caldera House is in the heart of Teton Village, a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram.
facts.excerpt: Caldera House is ideally situated in the heart of Teton Village, just a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram

facts.text: Grand Teton National Park is a short drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: An intimate boutique hotel nestled beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole in Teton Village, just steps away from the tram and a short drive to Grand Teton National Park.

facts.text: Caldera House is an intimate boutique hotel beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole.
facts.excerpt: An intimate boutique hotel nestled beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole in Teton Village

facts.text: Each suite has its own chef's kitchen and a spacious dining room.
facts.excerpt: Each equipped with its own chef’s kitchen and spacious dining room, our suites serve as excellent spaces to host a private dinner.

facts.text: The Yellowstone Suite, the largest two-bedroom suite, has slopeside views and its own in-house laundry.
facts.excerpt: The largest of our two-bedroom suites, Yellowstone features slopeside views and its own in-house laundry.

facts.text: The Socorro Suite is the most private two-bedroom suite and has its own library.
facts.excerpt: The most private of our two-bedroom suites, Socorro's is an airy and truly home-like space complete with its own well-curated library.

facts.text: The Kari Kari Suite has views of Sleeping Indian mountain in the distance.
facts.excerpt: With views of Sleeping Indian mountain in the distance, the Kari Kari Suite offers a sense of peace and quietude.

facts.text: The Taupo Suite is designed as a modernist sky retreat with a darker color palette and rich textiles.
facts.excerpt: Designed as a modernist sky retreat, the Taupo Suite creates an unmistakably inviting mood with its darker color palette and rich textiles.

facts.text: The Taupo four-bedroom suite has a heated terrace, a firepit and a soaking tub in the bathroom.
facts.excerpt: with a heated terrace, firepit and a soaking tub in the bathroom

facts.text: The hotel has modern furnishings from designers such as John Pawson and Patricia Urquiola.
facts.excerpt: Modern furnishings from designers such as John Pawson and Patricia Urquiola.

facts.text: Guests have 24-hour access to a fitness studio with Peloton bikes, a heated outdoor infinity plunge and a cedar dry sauna.
facts.excerpt: Guests have 24-hour access to our fitness studio, equipped with Peloton bikes and yoga corner, as well as our heated outdoor infinity plunge and cedar dry sauna.

facts.text: Massages and therapies are available in the treatment room or in-suite on request.
facts.excerpt: A number of massages and therapies are available in our treatment room or in-suite upon request.

facts.text: The Mudroom sports shop on the ground level was founded by Jackson Hole local Gov Carrigan.
facts.excerpt: Tucked into the ground level of Caldera House, Mudroom is a specialty mountain shop built on a passion for the mountains, exceptional equipment, and personal service. Founded by Jackson Hole local legend Gov Carrigan

facts.text: A dedicated concierge customizes adventures from dog sledding and snow trekking to whitewater rafting and fly fishing.
facts.excerpt: From dog sledding and snow trekking to whitewater rafting and fly fishing, we customize every adventure to suit your seasonal tastes.

facts.text: The hotel offers a private stargazing tour in Grand Teton National Park, reserved for your group.
facts.excerpt: A private stargazing tour deep within Grand Teton National Park, reserved exclusively for your group

facts.text: Backcountry ski trips through Grand Teton National Park are led by an Exum Mountain Guide.
facts.excerpt: Accompanied by an experienced Exum Mountain Guide

facts.text: A sleigh ride on the National Elk Refuge brings guests within feet of the migrating elk herd.
facts.excerpt: Get within feet of the largest migrating Elk herd in America

facts.text: Corsa nods to authentic trattorias in the Italian Alps.
facts.excerpt: Corsa was created to capture the rustic and laid-back vibe of Jackson Hole, while nodding to authentic trattorias in the Italian Alps.

facts.text: The Members Lounge has a full bar, a large slopeside outdoor patio and fire pits.
facts.excerpt: Our Member’s Lounge—equipped with full bar, large slopeside-facing outdoor patio, and fire pits

facts.text: The hotel offers valet parking and a ski concierge.
facts.excerpt: it's worth it for the valet parking alone (Jackson Hole resort has zero parking) and the ski concierge

facts.text: The hotel keeps a costume closet so guests can dress up for local holidays.
facts.excerpt: adding touches like a costume closet so you can dress up for local holidays

facts.text: The hotel recommends contacting it early so it can secure guides and activities before your stay.
facts.excerpt: We recommend contacting the hotel as soon as possible so we can secure the best guides and activities prior to your stay.
